entities.name: Isak Glen'Dard
entities.description: Shapeshifter messenger, diplomat and spy in the Dark Age of Terisiare on Dominaria, working as a triple agent.

entities.name: Digody
entities.description: Advisor to Lord Peemel for whom Isak worked more directly.

entities.name: Offero
entities.description: Inquisitor and dangerous contact to whom Isak delivered messages.

entities.name: Sacumon
entities.description: Sorceress who instigated the war between minotaurs and elves; died fighting Yunnie and Coernn.

entities.name: Ihesia
entities.description: Lady and Isak's lover, for whom he also secretly worked.

entities.name: Yunnie
entities.description: Fighter who discarded the Living Armor.

entities.name: Coernn
entities.description: Fighter who killed Sacumon along with Yunnie.

entities.name: Mytaru
entities.description: Character who used the Living Armor against the stone titan and died.

entities.name: Tiyint
entities.description: Stone titan fought in the battle.

entities.name: Niroso
entities.description: Group Sacumon met in the caves.

entities.name: Living Armor
entities.description: Artifact armor Isak takes and hides under his clothes.

entities.name: Urhaalan Valley
entities.description: Home of the minotaurs in the war.

entities.name: Eln Forest
entities.description: Home of the elves in the war.

events.summary: Isak works as a go-between for the powerful, ostensibly for Lord Peemel but more directly for Digody, and secretly for Ihesia, making him a triple agent.
events.quote: effectively making him a triple agent

events.summary: After war breaks out between minotaurs and elves, all of Isak's superiors order him to kill Sacumon, who instigated it.
events.quote: Isak received orders from all of his superiors to kill the sorceress Sacumon

events.summary: Isak arrives too late; Sacumon has already died fighting Yunnie and Coernn.
events.quote: She had already lost her life fighting Yunnie and Coernn.

events.summary: Mytaru uses the Living Armor against the stone titan at the cost of his own life.
events.quote: at the cost of his own life

events.summary: Isak pries the Living Armor from Mytaru's corpse and secretly wears it.
events.quote: He put the Living Armor onto himself
